reviews.title: Solid Choice, As Far As This Novice Knows
reviews.comment: First things first, I'm kind of a novice when it comes to PC stuff. I bought a prebuilt, it had 8GB of DDR4. I upgraded to 16GB pretty soon after, but it just wasn't holding up. Bought the Viper 2 x 32GB kit and I have had zero complaints. My average load is much more tolerable (no more worrying about RAM hogs like Chrome or Opera). RGB is a nice touch. I got these on sale, so I really have to say I'm happy with it.
reviews.author: Surveying Lands

reviews.title: Technically not the fastest but with 64GB it doesn't matter
reviews.comment: I use my PC for work, gaming and photo editing.  On their own I don't need 64gb of ram but when it's a good price, good kit, and 64GB of RAM why not?  I have not experienced any slow down or issues due to RAM or memory speed and churns through my graphic editor like butter.  Definitely worth it if you have the extra money.
reviews.author: JGalarza

reviews.title: Lightning fast RAM
reviews.comment: I installed 4 32Gb cards onto my Asus B550-F motherboard, which supports a max of 128Gb. My system is humming. Under full load running starfield, streaming music and recording RAM usage is still less than ten percent. The RGB feature adds the build, and is easily managed through aura sync.
reviews.author: Adam

reviews.title: Full calidad
reviews.comment: La PC va muy bien con este kit de ram de 64gb, excelente precio y fácil instalación. No tengo ninguna queja y ya van 4 meses desde que la compre
reviews.author: Jonathan Aguilar Garcia

reviews.title: Great RAM for the price
reviews.comment: I bought this for a gaming PC I was building to replace my old Alienware.  The first set I bought, one of the sticks was DOA.  I had used patriot RAM for a few years without issue in another PC I had built with no issues, so I decided to exchange it for a new set rather than returning it and going with a different brand.  So far, I have had no issues with the replacements and it benchmarks great.
reviews.author: Michael H
